extraction.Name: John Colomb, Jr.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded October 14, 1918, by John Colombe, Jr.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Security Bank of Winner for $1000 on November 14, 1918; mortgaged to J. L. Brown for $1172.20 on April 19, 1919; conveyed to Richard D. Gammon for $8000 by deed dated May 1, 1919
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612767 issued; North half of Southeast quarter, North half of Southwest quarter, Section 16, township 98, north of range 77; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 13, 1918; Colomb and his wife were parties to both mortgages and the conveyance
